title: I, V and V7 only
description: Stage 1: major-key harmony limited to I, V and V7. The dominant seventh belongs to the simplest stage.

title: Adds IV: I, IV, V and V7
description: Stage 2: adds IV, the subdominant, to I, V and V7.

title: Triads with vi
description: Adds vi, the relative-minor triad, to the primary chords.

title: Triads with ii
description: Includes ii, the minor supertonic triad.

title: Triads with iii or vii diminished
description: Includes iii, the minor mediant, or the leading-tone diminished triad.

title: Other seventh chords and extensions
description: Includes seventh chords other than V7, plus richer chord extensions. V7 counts at Stage 1.
